build_lstm_action_model: build an LSTM-based action-conditional model using LSTMModel with action_spec, out_spec, head_mlp_hiddens, and lstm_size parameters
create_action_model_factory: create an action model instance by calling get_action_model with name 'lstm' and required constructor arguments
run_model_step: run a model step on an LSTMState embedding to get transition outputs and head predictions for all actions
build_root_embedding: build a root node LSTMState from the agent's flattened state using a linear layer and tanh activation
review_model_transition_all_actions: review the LSTMModel _model_transition_all_actions method that performs one-hot action conditioning through an LSTM layer
